name: Gender Identity Clinic (GIC) – North London NHS Foundation Trust
address: Tavistock Centre, 120 Belsize Lane, London NW3 5BA
description: NHS adult gender identity clinic for England (17+ referrals, seen from 18). Requires referral from a GP or other healthcare professional; waiting lists are very long.

name: TransPlus – Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
address: 56 Dean Street, London W1D 6AQ
description: NHS adult gender service based at a sexual health centre in Soho, listed among England's gender dysphoria clinics. Referral required; not a walk-in service.

name: Porterbrook Clinic – Gender Identity Service, Sheffield Health and Social Care NHS FT
address: Michael Carlisle Centre, 75 Osborne Road, Sheffield S11 9BF
description: NHS adult gender identity clinic (18+). Accepts referrals from GPs and other healthcare professionals; long waiting list.

name: Leeds Gender Identity Service – Leeds and York Partnership NHS FT
address: The Newsam Centre, Seacroft Hospital, York Road, Leeds LS14 6UH
description: NHS adult gender identity service with gender outreach workers and information on commonly used medicines. GP or professional referral required.

name: Northern Region Gender Dysphoria Service (NRGDS) – CNTW NHS FT
address: Benfield House, Walkergate Park, Benfield Road, Newcastle upon Tyne NE6 4PF
description: NHS adult gender dysphoria service for the north of England. Referral from a GP or healthcare professional is required.

name: Transcend – Mersey Care NHS Foundation Trust
address: 151 Dale Street, Liverpool L2 2AH
description: NHS adult gender service in Liverpool listed among England's gender dysphoria clinics. Access is through NHS referral.

name: Indigo Gender Service
address: New Century House, Progress Way, Denton, Manchester M34 2GP
description: NHS-commissioned adult gender service for Greater Manchester, delivered in community settings. Access is through NHS referral.

name: Gender Identity Clinic – Northamptonshire Healthcare NHS FT
address: Danetre Hospital, H Block, London Road, Daventry NN11 4DY
description: NHS adult gender identity clinic in the Midlands. GP referral required.

name: The Nottingham Centre for Transgender Health – Nottinghamshire Healthcare NHS FT
address: 12 Broad Street, Nottingham NG1 3AL
description: NHS adult gender clinic in Nottingham; it also leads the East of England pilot gender service. Referral needed.

name: The Laurels – West of England Specialist Gender Identity Clinic (Devon Partnership NHS Trust)
address: The Laurels, 11-15 Dix's Field, Exeter EX1 1QA
description: NHS adult gender identity clinic (18+). From 1 October 2026 it no longer takes direct referrals: new referrals go through the national Gender National Referral Support Service.

name: NHS Children and Young People's Gender Service (London)
address: Great Ormond Street Hospital, Great Ormond Street, London WC1N 3JH
description: Regional NHS gender service for under-18s, run by Evelina London, Great Ormond Street and South London and Maudsley. Referrals come via children's mental health or paediatric services through the national referral support service, not directly from GPs.

name: NHS Children and Young People's Gender Service (North West)
address: Alder Hey Children's Hospital, Eaton Road, Liverpool L12 2AP
description: Regional NHS gender service for children and young people up to 18, run by Alder Hey and Royal Manchester Children's Hospital. GPs cannot refer directly: referrals come from paediatric or mental health services via the national referral support service.

name: NHS Children and Young People's Gender Service (South West)
address: Bristol Royal Hospital for Children, Upper Maudlin Street, Bristol BS2 8BJ
description: Regional NHS gender service for under-18s based at Bristol Royal Hospital for Children. Referrals come via children's mental health or paediatric services through the national referral support service.

name: Sandyford Adult Gender Service – NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde
address: Sandyford Central, 6 Sandyford Place, Glasgow G3 7NB
description: NHS gender service for adults (18+) in Scotland. Referral from a GP or Adult Mental Health Service is required; waiting times are very long.

name: Sandyford Young Person Gender Service – NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde
address: Sandyford Central, 6 Sandyford Place, Glasgow G3 7NB
description: Scotland's only NHS gender service for under-18s, covering the whole country. Referral from a GP, paediatric services or CAMHS is required.

name: Chalmers Gender Identity Clinic – NHS Lothian
address: 2A Chalmers Street, Edinburgh EH3 9ES
description: NHS gender identity clinic for people aged 17 and over living in NHS Lothian, Borders and Fife. GP referral required.

name: Grampian Gender Identity Clinic – NHS Grampian
address: Royal Cornhill Hospital, Cornhill Road, Aberdeen AB25 2ZH
description: NHS gender identity clinic for adults (18+) living in the NHS Grampian area. GP referral required.

name: Highland Gender Identity Clinic – Highland Sexual Health (NHS Highland)
address: Highland Sexual Health, Royal Northern Infirmary, Ness Walk, Inverness IV3 5SF
description: NHS adult gender identity clinic (18+) for people living in the NHS Highland area. GP referral required; first appointment is usually with a gender nurse by phone.

name: Welsh Gender Service – Cardiff and Vale University Health Board
address: St David's Hospital, Cowbridge Road East, Cardiff CF11 9XB
description: National NHS gender service for adults in Wales, working with local gender teams in each health board. GP referral required (accepted from 17, care starts at 18); gender-affirming surgery referrals are paused pending a clinical review.

name: Brackenburn Clinic – Regional Gender Identity Service (Belfast HSC Trust)
address: Unit 15, Shimna House, Knockbracken Healthcare Park, Saintfield Road, Belfast BT8 8BH
description: Northern Ireland's adult gender identity service. Referral from a GP or other healthcare professional from age 17.5; very long waiting times.

name: Knowing Our Identity (KOI) – Belfast HSC Trust
address: Beechcroft, Forster Green Hospital, 110 Saintfield Road, Belfast BT8 6GR
description: Northern Ireland's NHS gender service for children and young people up to 18 and their families. Referrals usually come from CAMHS or learning disability services.

name: CliniQ
address: Caldecot Centre, 15-22 Caldecot Road, London SE5 9RS
description: Trans-led sexual health and wellbeing service for trans, non-binary and gender-diverse people, offering STI/HIV testing, PrEP/PEP and wellbeing support. Not a gender identity clinic.

name: LGBT Foundation
address: Fairbairn House (2nd Floor), 72 Sackville Street, Manchester M1 3NJ
description: National LGBTQ+ charity based in Manchester with trans and non-binary advice, support services and a helpline. No referral needed.

name: Gendered Intelligence
description: Trans-led charity running youth groups for trans, non-binary and questioning young people (in-person in London and Leeds, plus online), and groups for parents and carers.

name: Gendered Intelligence Support Line
description: Free, confidential phone, email and WhatsApp support for trans people (and those close to them) waiting for NHS gender-affirming healthcare. Opening hours vary week to week.

name: Mermaids Support Line
description: UK charity support line and webchat for trans and gender-diverse children and young people and their families. Free to call.

name: Switchboard LGBTQIA+ Support Line
description: UK-wide LGBTQIA+ support line answered by volunteers from the community, by phone, instant message or email.

name: Galop – National Helpline for LGBT+ Victims and Survivors of Abuse and Violence
description: Helpline for LGBT+ adults (18+) experiencing domestic abuse, sexual violence, hate crime, conversion practices or other abuse, with guidance on options.

name: Mindline Trans+ (Mind in Somerset)
description: UK-wide confidential emotional support line for trans, non-binary and gender-diverse people, staffed by listeners with lived experience. Evening opening only; check current hours.

name: LGBT Health and Wellbeing (Edinburgh)
address: Duncan Place Hub, 4 Duncan Place, Edinburgh EH6 8HW
description: Scottish LGBTQ+ charity with trans and non-binary support programmes and a free helpline (0800 464 7000). No referral needed.

name: LGBT Health and Wellbeing (Glasgow)
address: 14 North Claremont Street, Glasgow G3 7LE
description: Glasgow base of the Scottish LGBTQ+ charity, offering trans and non-binary support alongside its helpline. No referral needed.

name: Scottish Trans
address: Tribe Porty, 19 Windsor Place, Edinburgh EH15 2AJ
description: Scotland's trans equality project, providing information on rights, healthcare and legal gender recognition, and campaigning for trans people in Scotland.

name: TransgenderNI
description: Trans-led human rights and community organisation for Northern Ireland; runs the Belfast Trans Resource Centre with peer groups and drop-ins.

name: The Rainbow Project (Belfast)
address: LGBT Centre, 23-31 Waring Street, Belfast BT1 2DX
description: LGBTQ+ health and wellbeing charity offering free counselling and monthly sexual health screening for trans people in Belfast.

name: The Rainbow Project (Derry/Londonderry)
address: Waterloo House, Magazine Street, Londonderry BT48 6HH
description: North-west office of the Rainbow Project, offering LGBTQ+ support and counselling including for trans people.

name: Trans Aid Cymru
description: Volunteer-run mutual aid for trans, non-binary and intersex people in Wales: small grants, signposting, a trans-friendly GP map and social events in Cardiff and Newport.

name: Intercom Trust
address: Zone 5, Wrentham Business Centre, Prospect Park, Exeter EX4 6NA
description: LGBTQ+ community charity for the South West with a helpline and support around transphobic prejudice, hate crime and discrimination.

name: The Clare Project
address: The Ledward Centre, 14a Jubilee Street, Brighton BN1 1GE
description: Trans-led charity supporting trans, non-binary and intersex people in Brighton and Sussex with drop-ins, peer support and care navigation for the Sussex Gender Service.

name: The Proud Trust
address: 49-51 Sidney Street, Manchester M1 7HB
description: LGBT+ youth charity based at Manchester's LGBT+ Centre, supporting young people including trans and questioning youth, and schools on trans inclusion.

name: TransActual
description: Trans-led UK organisation providing information on medical transition, gender clinics and legal rights, and research on trans people's experiences. Online only.

name: Not A Phase
description: Trans-led charity for trans+ adults across the UK, running Trans+Connect peer socials and community programmes.

name: FFLAG – Families and Friends of Lesbians and Gays
description: National charity supporting parents and families of LGBT+ people, including families of trans children and adults, through a helpline and local groups.

name: Trans Legal Clinic
description: Trans-led legal service offering free and accessible legal help to trans and non-binary people. Contact through the website.

name: Black Trans Alliance
address: 124 City Road, London EC1V 2NX
description: UK organisation offering peer-to-peer support, a helpline and safe spaces for Black trans people, alongside campaigning on trans rights. Its site shows news from May 2026.

name: Butterfly Clinic (axess, Liverpool)
address: The Beat, 6 David Lewis Street, Liverpool L1 4AF
description: Confidential sexual health clinic for trans and non-binary people run by axess, with Monday sessions at The Beat and a Tuesday clinic in Huyton. Health records are kept separate from other NHS records. The page shows no explicit 2025-2026 dates.

name: Clinic T (Brighton Sexual Health)
description: Trans-affirming sexual health clinic for trans, non-binary and gender-questioning people, held on the second Wednesday evening of each month by booked appointment. Based at the SHAC East site (Claude Nicol Centre), with no postcode published on the page.

name: TransSober
description: Non-profit peer support for trans and non-binary people affected by drug or alcohol use, with Monday drop-ins at The Queery (temporary venue) and online Thursday groups. Event pages list dates in November 2026.

name: TYG (Trans Youth Glasgow) – LGBT Youth Scotland
description: Trans-specific youth group run by LGBT Youth Scotland for trans young people in Glasgow, part of its youth work for LGBTQ+ people aged 13-25. A September 2026 post shows the group still meeting; find current sessions via the local group finder.
